title: Tockmox / Overview
description: L0: the platform at a glance. Component health, capacity, AI routing and spend. Every tile links down to its L1 board.

options.content: Magic is just well-documented engineering
**The platform at a glance.** Grey means *no data*, which is never healthy: the source did not answer or is not installed. Each tile links to its board.

panels.title: Platform verdict
panels.description: OK needs two facts: no critical alert firing AND the always-firing Watchdog present. Without the heartbeat, an empty alert list proves nothing, so the tile reads UNKNOWN.

targets.expr: ((count(ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="critical"}) or on() vector(0)) and on() (count(ALERTS{alertname="Watchdog",alertstate="firing"}) > 0)) or on() vector(-1)

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: Excludes Watchdog and InfoInhibitor by severity. Read with the verdict: zero here is only good news while the heartbeat is present.

panels.title: GitOps layers not Synced + Healthy
panels.description: Argo CD applications that are out of sync or not healthy. Grey: Argo CD metrics are not scraped (apps.argocdMonitoring), which is not the same as all synced.

targets.expr: count(argocd_app_info unless argocd_app_info{sync_status="Synced",health_status="Healthy"}) or (count(argocd_app_info) * 0) or on() vector(-1)

panels.title: Scrape targets down
panels.description: Prometheus targets that stopped answering. A target that was never configured is not counted; this is the 'it was there and went away' signal.

panels.title: Endpoints answering
panels.description: Blackbox probes of every console: the user's view of 'is it up'. Grey: no probes configured.

panels.title: Days since a restore drill passed
panels.description: Backups are only proven by a restore. The newest successful restore-drill CronJob; drills run as Argo CronWorkflows are not seen here until they emit a success metric (see the design doc).

panels.title: Certificates not ready
panels.description: cert-manager Certificates whose Ready condition is false: the TLS a console is about to serve wrong or not at all.

panels.title: AI: local versus frontier, and spend
Served locally, last 24h
panels.description: Share of AI requests the policy gate served from a local model (tockmox_gate_served_total, endpoint_tier). The gate's tier is the authority: LiteLLM's api_provider says 'openai' for a local OpenAI-compatible server, so it cannot tell local from frontier. No threshold: the right share is a site decision.

panels.title: Frontier spend
panels.description: LiteLLM's computed cost (USD by its price map; not an invoice). Counts what went through the gateway only: a subscription used directly is not here. Local models cost 0 here unless a notional price is set.

panels.title: Frontier spend by model, last 7 days
Least budget left on a gateway key
AI nodes on an unverified configuration
panels.description: Enrolled inference nodes whose last converge ran a commit whose signature did not verify. Grey: no AI node is enrolled.

panels.title: Restricted traffic served off-site (24h)
panels.description: Requests the gate classed restricted that were served by a frontier model. The policy says this is zero; anything else is a control that failed.
